title: Glacier Rivers: Abstract Pattern Editing in Alaska

date.basis: Embedded creation_time suggests export date; transcript supports Alaska as location but not shooting date.

locations.name: Alaska
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly mentions Alaska in relation to glacial rivers; not necessarily shooting location.

summary: This video demonstrates a practical workflow for turning glacial-river photography into abstract, pattern-driven compositions. It begins with scene evaluation to identify crisscrossing braided channels and depth-based color cues (shallow blue water vs. deeper muddy water and dark sandbars). The editing sequence prioritizes dynamic-range expansion by lifting blacks/shadows, restoring highlights with whites, then adjusting color temperature and tint to create mood. Texture and clarity are added, followed by a curves-based contrast lift; saturation is tuned to taste. The presenter shows applying the same edits across multiple frames with presets, Auto Apply, and Apply Previous Settings to extract multiple compositions from a single location. In later segments, attention shifts to shallow-sand patterns, autofocus considerations, and targeted HSL color sculpting (blue luminance, orange/yellow luminance, and magenta hues) to reveal striking gold-and-blue abstractions. The result is a library of high-contrast, geometric river abstracts grounded in the underlying water-depth and sand textures.

sections.title: Scene assessment: identifying crisscross river patterns
sections.description: The presenter explains looking for crisscrossing patterns and depth-based color cues (shallow blue water, muddy deeper water, dark sandbars) to select compelling shots.

sections.title: Exposure management and initial color tweaks
sections.description: Lifts blacks/shadows to expand dynamic range, restores exposure with whites, then warms color temperature and nudges tint toward purple.

sections.title: Texture, clarity, and curves for contrast
sections.description: Adds texture/clarity and uses curves to boost contrast, then explores slight saturation adjustments to emphasize river patterns.

sections.title: Applying adjustments across areas with presets
sections.description: Demonstrates applying the same preset to other river patterns and using Apply Previous Settings to replicate edits across frames, with per-area color-temperature tweaks.

sections.title: Sand patterns, autofocus, and final HSL refinement
sections.description: Explores shallow-sand abstractions, notes autofocus misses on very shallow textures, then uses HSL to tailor blue/orange/yellow tones—creating striking gold-and-blue sand abstractions and highlighting the value of presets for rapid multi-shot editing.
